description: This source file is a PHP script handling AJAX requests for webmail functionalities within the vtiger CRM, including mailbox operations like expunge, delete, move, undelete, and flag management.

classes.name: MailBox
classes.description: Represents an IMAP mailbox, providing methods for mailbox operations.

classes.name: Webmails
classes.description: Represents individual webmail messages, providing methods for message management.

methods.name: checkFileAccessForInclusion
methods.description: Checks whether a file is accessible for inclusion, security check.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues.

methods.name: cal_start
methods.description: Calculates the starting page index for displaying mail list based on current start parameter and total mails.
